novelty_review.scope: Internal engineering review for native validation; not external acceptance
novelty_review.rationale: Correcting an existing mispatch while preserving a working link tests maintenance rework. Both releasable catches and anchored continuous cable paths constrain the operation; a temporary parking cradle frees the occupied destination.
novelty_review.risk: Moderate mapping overlap and substantial dynamic risk: articulated cable self-contact and coordinated release require native proof. Offline cable endpoint slack is not a collision-free flexible trajectory.

review_notes: Passive mechanics, source-defined contact geometry, measured-state controller and native probes implemented. Offline geometry cannot establish physical success. No task may enter the submission handoff before runtime evidence passes.
